title: Exponential Concentration Inequalities For Independent Random Vectors Under Sublinear Expectations
summary: Li and Hu recently established variance-type O(1/n) bounds for the sample mean of independent random vectors under sublinear expectations. We extend their results to the exponential concentration regime.
